sio2_melting_1_subtask_structure_retriev.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_structure_retriev.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.name: SiO2 Potential File for Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_melting_1_subtask_melting.name: SiO2 NPT Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible alpha quartz SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file, simulate melting under NPT with the given simulation parameters. Return the path to the trajectory file and the final density of the melt in g/cm^3.

sio2_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.name: SiO2 Diffusivity Calculation - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_diffusivity.description: Given the path to the trajectory file from the melting simulation, compute the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Si and O atoms over the trajectory using the MDAnalysis library. Identify the melting point as the first frame where the MSD shows a sudden jump, ignoring the first 50 ps of simulation. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state using the MSD after the detected melting point, and report the average value in m²/s.
